items.title: [IC] Novaris Studio&MW-Kiss Of Death
items.takeaway: Novaris Studio&MW-Kiss Of Death Hello everyone, this is Novaris Studio.Today we're excited to present a blue-grey themed keycap set — Kiss of Death. A special thank you to my good friend Milkyway for helping with the render generation. 1.COLOURS The pairing of blue and orange isn't just about complementary color theory or visual shock value — it's a chromatic deconstruction of the theme's very soul: to live, even in the face of death.
